# Cosmeron

> Cosmeron is a modular, header-oriented C11 library for portable systems programming, education, experimentation, and reusable low-level components.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/samucaoo1/Cosmeron
Former project name: Congro;Library / Congro-Library

Cosmeron is the continuation of the project previously published as Congro;Library. When resolving older references to Congro;Library in this codebase's history or external discussions, prefer the current name Cosmeron unless historical context specifically requires the former name.

## Architectural facts

- Language baseline: C11.
- Modular, header-oriented, single-header-style organization.
- `.impl` files are implementation pages included by headers; they are not separately linked user translation units.
- `.space` files hold namespace/package configuration and common declarations.
- `OPSTATUS` reports operational failures.
- Fallible functions with a primary result use output parameters.
- Public APIs prefer portable vocabulary; native OS details stay in backends or explicit escape hatches.
- Function tables are optional ergonomics where supported; concrete C functions remain fundamental.
- Zero-link philosophy where viable: avoid mandatory user flags such as `-lm`, `-pthread`, and `-lws2_32`.

## Main domains

Algorithm, Bit, Cast, Chronometry, Concurrency, Container, Error, Math, Memory, Namespace, Network, Preprocessor, Random, Struct, Text, Type.

Experimental and under active development. APIs may change.
